speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked	the Minister for Health (a) whether the Ministry will consider regulating managed care and Third Party Administrator (TPA) companies as healthcare entities; and (b) how can transparency on the fee arrangements between doctors, TPAs and insurers be improved.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In addition, the insurers should disclose to their policyholders any financial arrangements they have with the doctors.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH will monitor the situation and, where necessary, we will not hesitate to take further steps to protect the interests and well-being of patients and safeguard the integrity of our healthcare system.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: One, is there a need for MOH to regulate the practice of percentage-based fee arrangements?

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: Two, how do we mitigate against TPAs from resulting in undue medical fee increases for patients; and three, has there been any breach of the disclosure requirements by MOH?

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: The Minister of State clarified earlier that there will be timing requirements for the insurers to disclose to improve transparency of fee arrangements.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: First, as I explained in my answer, we need to regulate such fee arrangements to protect the well-being of patients and to prevent conflict of interest.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: We do not want the TPAs to end up driving up healthcare costs and affecting patient care.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: These are the primary considerations for MOH and SMC when the SMC issues its guidelines.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: On the breach of disclosure requirements, I do not think there is currently a breach because the requirements have not taken effect.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: After the requirements have taken effect, we would certainly monitor the compliance and make sure that TPAs which have such arrangements, and doctors who are in such arrangements with TPAs, the information would be disclosed appropriately to patients.
